checks: actual callable browser preflight and guest rejection
caller cannot choose another owner, arbitrary peer, invalid mode or malformed interests
real owners join private queues and modes remain separate
both real Auth owners observe one current canonical pair with minimal peer metadata
text handoff creates one readable participant conversation and denies an outsider
even participants cannot bypass the gateway to raw private sessions or match records
reload resumes one owned search; cancellation closes that exact pair and replay cannot revive it
actual out-of-order Cancel tombstone prevents a delayed first join from entering any queue
a failed domain commit does not mint a queue or success receipt
disabled Auth before commit rolls back matching writes
actual same-second UID replacement with different raw creation milliseconds is rejected before commit
a retired canonical binding cannot enter matching
expired presence cannot match an abandoned search
late old-operation cleanup preserves the newer owned queue
blocks are enforced across both historical aliases and revoke an already matched pair
existing active parental feature restrictions prevent entering Roulette
three concurrent real joins produce one pair and one waiting owner, without double matching
video handoff reserves one call initiator and replays the same conversation
audio mode pairs and hands off through the same checked participant capability
legacy raw matching records cannot become authority and remain unchanged
scope: Actual Node22 callable HTTP, real demo Firebase Auth tokens/Firestore SDK/transactions and exact deployed Rules. Synthetic failure/clock/race injection is confined to this exclusive loopback QA server. No production, provider, real user contact, camera or microphone action. Text/audio/video handoff is checked; actual media calls are not certified.
